findings.observed: At 1348 px in the signed-in test session the cart is at x=1379–1405, outside the clipped viewport.
findings.cause: Header content exceeds available desktop width; document overflow clipping hides the cart.
findings.proposedRepair: Use a responsive header layout that reserves space for account/cart and allows the other tracks to shrink or wrap; keep all navigation and search available.

findings.observed: The Samsung brand printer selector and /api/printers?q=ML-2165W return no match. ML-2165 returns one canonical model with three products. Main autocomplete and the direct W-model detail work.
findings.cause: buildPrinterIndex groups consumable-equivalent models and retains the shortest display title. API q and printer-finder.js filter only that title, losing the W alias.
findings.proposedRepair: Retain verified supplier model aliases for each grouped printer and search those aliases in both API and browser. Preserve exact series and existing canonical URLs; do not strip suffixes blindly.

findings.observed: memoryLimitConfigured=false; cgroupLimitMb and effectiveMemoryLimitMb are null.
Lexmark 56F2X0E, Canon CRG-045BK and Kyocera TK-3160 retain placeholder images despite available image URLs.

caveats: No production restart, forced GC or manual import. This is a bounded live test, not proof of leak-free multi-day operation.

ai.message: Aký je rozdiel medzi tonerom, optickým valcom a odpadovou nádobou?
answer: Toner, optický valec a odpadová nádoba:
Toner dodáva prášok na tlač. Optický valec (drum) vytvára obraz a prenáša toner; môže byť samostatný alebo súčasťou tonerovej kazety.
Odpadová nádoba zachytáva zvyškový toner, ktorý sa pri tlači nepoužil. Nie je náhradou tonera ani optického valca; pri hlásení o jej naplnení sa postupuje podľa návodu konkrétnej tlačiarne.
Napíšte presný model tlačiarne a chybové hlásenie, aby sme určili správny diel.
